Mounting Locations Recommended Wall Mounting Locations The remote sensor should be mounted or placed approximately 4 to 5 feet above the floor. Select an area with average temperature and good air circulation. Mounting Locations Wall Mount - Removable 1 Mount T-bracket on the wall. Wall mount slot s NO NO YES NO T- bracket Do not mount or place Remote Sensors in locations: • Close to hot or cold air ducts • That are in direct sunlight • With an outside wall behind the thermostat • In areas that do not require conditioning • Where there are dead spots or drafts (in corners or behind doors) • Where appliances could radiate heat • Do not set it next to or on hot appliances • Do not put it in your pocket or hold in your hands for a long period of time. • Body heat will distort the temperature reading. 2 Slide the Remote Sensor over the mounted T-bracket. Remote Sensing New Features Example of programming a priority for the SLEEP time period: the program should remain on system average. When on the SLEEP time period during programming, press NEXT ZONE until Bedroom 1 shows. During the SLEEP time period the other remotes in the house will be ignored and the system will be controlled only by the ambient temperature of the remote in the master bedroom. The WAKE, LEAVE and RETURN temperature will be controlled by the system average. New Features on the Thermostat After a remote is Connected NEXT ZONE KEY Mon 10:03AM Set At 74 + LEAVE ** 74F SYSTEM AVERAGE Next Zone Menu SYSTEM Cool FAN Auto In this example, the name of the zone currently having priority is SYSTEM AVERAGE. System average is the average of all connected sensors. Local is the ambient temperature of the Thermostat. NEXT ZONE key cycles through ambient temperatures for connected zones. The name of the REMOTE can be displayed. This shows it has priority. Remote Sensing New Features New Features on the Thermostat After a remote is Connected THERMOSTAT HOLD (PERMANENT) Mon 10:03AM Set At + Hold74 LEAVE ** 74F SYSTEM AVERAGE Next Zone Hold Run Schedule SYSTEM Cool FAN Auto To put the thermostat into hold select system average or the zone you want to hold. Then use the arrows to adjust the setpoint. Then press the HOLD key. HOLD: Indicates the Thermostat is in permanent HOLD. A permanent HOLD can be active for system average, local, or any REMOTE. Run Schedule: Will cancel any holds and return the system to the program.
